ideas.canonical_en: He claims a VC just signed a term sheet, but it's actually a pizza coupon.
ideas.hook: Just closed a seed round with a top‑tier VC—valuation's through the roof.
ideas.twist: The term sheet is a pizza coupon from a local shop.

backlog.canonical_en: He claims his sunrise meditation fuels a billion-dollar vision, but he's just scrolling memes.
backlog.hook: I start my day at 4:30 AM with a power meditation that aligns my empire.
backlog.setup: Morning meditation while visualizing a multi‑billion valuation.
backlog.twist: Actually I'm just watching cat memes on my phone.
backlog.visual_gag: Phone screen showing a cat meme overlayed with a headset.

backlog.canonical_en: He announces a breakthrough AI tool, but the 'AI' is a toaster.
backlog.hook: Launching our AI‑driven platform that will automate every task.
backlog.setup: Teasing AI product that will change industry.
backlog.twist: It's just a toaster I named 'AI‑Toast'.
backlog.visual_gag: Toaster with a small screen showing 'AI' logo.

backlog.canonical_en: He boasts about scaling the team, but his only employee is a rubber chicken.
backlog.hook: We're hiring top talent who can pivot faster than the market.
backlog.twist: My only employee is a rubber chicken named 'Pivot'.
backlog.visual_gag: Rubber chicken with a name tag on a desk.

backlog.canonical_en: He says his office has 5‑star views, but he's on a couch in a laundry room.
backlog.hook: My office overlooks the skyline—clouds of opportunity everywhere.
backlog.setup: Describing high‑rise office with panoramic view.
backlog.twist: I'm actually on a couch in the apartment laundry room.
backlog.visual_gag: Couch with laptop, laundry machines in background, window showing brick wall.

backlog.canonical_en: He says his board meetings are packed, but the board is just his houseplants.
backlog.hook: Our weekly boardroom is always full of visionary leaders.
backlog.setup: Board meeting with key stakeholders discussing growth.
backlog.twist: The only attendees are two succulents.
backlog.visual_gag: Succulents in tiny chairs around a conference table.

backlog.canonical_en: He claims his follower count is soaring, but the screen shows 0 likes.
backlog.hook: My LinkedIn followers exploded overnight—thousands of CEOs follow me.
backlog.twist: My latest post has zero likes and zero comments.
backlog.visual_gag: Phone screen with LinkedIn post showing 0 likes.

backlog.canonical_en: He boasts about payroll automation, but his paycheck is a doodle of a dollar sign.
backlog.hook: Our payroll system runs itself, paying every team member on time.
backlog.twist: My last paycheck was a doodle of a dollar sign on a napkin.
